quantized_representation.message: Live Int8Tensor weights have logical float32 dtype. The ordinary backend rewrites their functional linear calls to transpose/matmul nodes without explicitly lifting INT8 payloads, per-token activation quantization and scales into the checked IR. Local recognition of those floating forms is not recognition of the W8A8 computation.
